decisions.decision: Use REST API with v1 versioning
decisions.reason: Operational complexity and no demonstrated client need
decisions.quote: Rejected alternative: GraphQL-first. Reason: higher operational complexity and no demonstrated client need. We can revisit when external clients request it.

decisions.decision: Use bearer tokens for user-facing calls and API keys for service-to-service calls
decisions.quote:
Rejected alternatives summary:
- GraphQL-first: rejected due to complexity and lack of client need.
- API keys only: rejected; users need short-lived bearer tokens.

Rejected alternatives summary:
- GraphQL-first: rejected due to complexity and lack of client need.
- API keys only: rejected; users need short-lived bearer tokens.
- Offset pagination: rejected due to inconsistent results under writes.

decisions.decision: Apply rate limiting at 100 req/min per credential
decisions.quote: Rate limiting at 100 req/min per token.
